proposal_requirements: Generate targeted explanations or initial documentation for code sections related to a user's question.
Support natural-language questions including Persian in the experimental scope.
Ground generated output in actual repository content and avoid speculative or irrelevant explanations.
Include useful items such as purpose, inputs, outputs, and related files or functions.
Evaluate consistency with code, understandability, and usefulness to developers.
Whole-repository automatic documentation and fully local execution are not mandatory commitments.

notable_failures: One English case invented a state-mutating side effect not supported by source.
Two reviewable cases omitted source-supported details.
The longest Persian CodeCompass case ended mid-string and was invalid JSON.
qwen.execution_history: The original six documentation attempts failed at the local provider boundary; all six were replayed from identical frozen inputs. Five replay outputs were complete and one was incomplete.

notable_failures: All three English documentation calls ended as invalid_response_empty_content.
One Persian documentation call ended as invalid_response_empty_content.
Two Persian documentation calls returned partial JSON with finish_reason=length.
One partial Persian output had already started a raises object shape that conflicts with the required list-of-strings schema.

offline_replay.conclusion: No stored complete output was incorrectly rejected by the documentation parser. The four GLM empty-content failures occurred before schema validation.

trusted: Symbol resolution, source path, line range, chunk identity, and citations come from SQLite metadata.
Exact parameter names, signature, return annotation, async status, and source code are supplied as trusted evidence.
adapter_constraints: The OpenAI-compatible adapter reads only choices[0].message.content.
Blank content is converted to invalid_response_empty_content before documentation validation.
The provider-neutral response preserves text, model, provider, and finish_reason, but not token usage or a sanitized response-envelope shape.
Non-standard reasoning_content is neither consumed nor recorded.

hypotheses.name: provider_issue
evidence_for: Four GLM documentation executions reached the adapter with blank canonical message.content and were classified invalid_response_empty_content.
The same GLM route produced usable content for five QA cases, so failure is specific to the documentation request shape or provider handling rather than total connectivity.
evidence_against_or_limits: Raw response envelopes were not retained, so it is unknown whether text existed in a non-standard field such as reasoning_content.
A blank canonical content field can originate from provider behavior, model serving behavior, or adapter incompatibility.
hypotheses.conclusion: A provider-boundary failure is confirmed; attribution to the external provider alone is not.

hypotheses.name: adapter_bug
evidence_for: The adapter accepts only message.content and has no compatibility path for non-standard reasoning_content.
No raw envelope or field-presence metadata was stored for the empty responses.
evidence_against_or_limits: Every stored non-empty output reached the result artifact; five complete Qwen outputs pass the current parser.
OpenAI-compatible canonical output is message.content, so ignoring an unproven provider extension is not itself proof of a defect.
The empty GLM envelopes are unavailable for offline replay.
hypotheses.conclusion: No integration fix is justified from existing evidence. A raw-envelope diagnostic is required before changing the adapter.

hypotheses.name: schema_contract_pressure
evidence_for: Documentation requires one strict eight-field JSON object while QA accepts ordinary text.
Both non-empty GLM documentation outputs terminated with finish_reason=length and incomplete JSON.
The most complex Persian Qwen documentation case also ended mid-string.
A partial GLM output was already diverging from the requested raises list-of-strings shape.
Prompt sizes ranged from 1474 to 4789 characters and place inference of raises, side effects, and dependencies on the model.
evidence_against_or_limits: Five Qwen documentation outputs completed under the same 1200-token setting.
The artifacts contain no token usage, so hidden reasoning-token consumption and output-token pressure cannot be separated.
hypotheses.conclusion: The current contract materially contributes to reliability risk, especially for longer symbols; it does not explain every empty GLM response by itself.

hypotheses.name: model_limitation
evidence_for: Qwen produced one unsupported side-effect claim, omitted source-supported behavior in two cases, and failed to complete one complex Persian output.
Qwen documentation quality averaged 6.5/10 despite trusted source evidence.
evidence_against_or_limits: Five of six Qwen outputs were schema-valid and reviewable.
GLM documentation quality cannot be scored because no execution produced a complete reviewable document.
Five reviewable GLM QA cases scored 10/10, arguing against a general GLM code-understanding failure.
hypotheses.conclusion: Qwen generation limitations are supported but entangled with contract complexity. GLM documentation capability is not measurable from this run.

hypotheses.name: persian_language_weakness
evidence_for: The Qwen Persian mean including the incomplete case was 5.33/10 versus 7.67/10 for English.
The incomplete Qwen documentation and both length-terminated GLM documentation outputs were Persian.
evidence_against_or_limits: English and Persian documentation cases target different symbols and have materially different source and prompt lengths.
The two reviewable Persian Qwen cases averaged 8.0/10, slightly above the English mean.
All three GLM English documentation cases returned empty content, while two Persian cases at least returned substantive partial content.
The benchmark is not a paired same-symbol language experiment.
hypotheses.conclusion: The current data do not establish a Persian-specific model weakness. They establish a completion/reliability problem that affected several Persian cases.

hypotheses.name: missing_deterministic_facts
evidence_for: The service deterministically owns identity, parameter names, signature, return annotation, and citation, but asks the model to infer raises, direct dependencies, side effects, and behavior from raw source.
Observed Qwen failures include an invented side effect and omitted commit, callback, transaction, and control-flow details.
The proposal requires grounded purpose, inputs, outputs, and related functions; syntax-visible facts can satisfy part of that requirement without model inference.
evidence_against_or_limits: Deterministic syntax facts cannot fully determine purpose or runtime semantics.
The complete source chunk is already present, so this is not missing evidence in the literal sense; it is missing deterministic ownership of facts.
hypotheses.conclusion: Moving syntax-visible facts out of model ownership is justified independently of provider choice.

decision_gate.recommended_next_step: Run one approved, non-scoring GLM documentation transport diagnostic on a simple frozen case using the unchanged request. Capture only a secret-safe response-envelope schema: choice keys, message keys, content length, reasoning_content length if present, finish_reason, and usage counts. Do not alter the adapter or benchmark first.

outcomes.content_empty_reasoning_present: Classify as provider compatibility/adapter gap; make the smallest explicit compatibility decision before model-quality testing.
outcomes.content_and_reasoning_empty: Record provider/model-serving limitation; do not change the validator.
outcomes.canonical_content_complete: Treat prior empty responses as transient and proceed to the paired language diagnostic.
outcomes.canonical_content_truncated: Treat contract/output-budget pressure as confirmed and begin M26 with deterministic facts plus a smaller narrative contract.

full_2_models_x_2_languages_x_2_symbols_.reason: It is required only to make a causal Persian-versus-English claim, because the existing language cases use different symbols. Running all eight calls before resolving the GLM envelope ambiguity would spend calls without isolating the first failure boundary.

overall_conclusion: The strongest current explanation is a combination of strict structured-output pressure and excessive model ownership of syntax-visible facts. A GLM provider/adapter boundary problem is also real, but the stored artifacts cannot assign it to provider or adapter. A Persian-specific weakness is not established.
